a.speaker: narrator
a.text: The Bridge. Once the heart of the Leviathan, now a cathedral of pink and violet light. Bloom growth covers every console, pulsing slowly, like breathing.

b.speaker: halcyon
b.text: Engineer Reyes. The Bloom's core has rooted itself into the helm. Navigation cannot be restored while it remains. Time to stellar intercept: {time}.

c.speaker: bolt
c.text: This is it, Kai. The last deck. Whatever is up there... it's the center of everything.

d.speaker: bolt
d.text: And I remember everything now. The pattern. The words. If we get close enough, I think I can talk to it.

e.speaker: bolt
e.text: Captain Voss's quarters are east of the hall. If her keycard still works, maybe she left something behind.

a.speaker: bolt
a.text: The command deck is past those sentinels and the growth. Once we go in there, there's no coming back out.

b.speaker: bolt
b.text: The escape pods are in the west bay. Just so you know. No judgment. Some judgment. Mostly no judgment.

a.speaker: narrator
a.text: The escape pod console glows. Five pods, fueled and ready. Launching one means abandoning the Leviathan and everyone aboard.

b.speaker: bolt
b.text: Kai... are we really thinking about leaving?

choices.text: Launch a pod. We're leaving. (Ends the game)

c.speaker: kai
c.text: Are we sure? Once that hatch closes, it's over.

go.speaker: bolt
go.text: Okay. Okay. I'll get the hatch.

stay.speaker: bolt
stay.text: Good. I didn't want to go anyway. Let's go save everybody.

a.speaker: narrator
a.text: At the helm, the Bloom Heart beats: a towering bulb of thorns and light, rooted into the navigation console, tendrils running into every system of the ship.

b.speaker: narrator
b.text: Its light flickers as you approach. Red. Red. Red.

c.speaker: bolt
c.text: Kai, it's scared. Red means danger. It thinks we're here to burn it, like Dray did.

d.speaker: bolt
d.text: Let me SPEAK to it in the fight. Three words: hello, safe, together. Just don't hurt it while I'm talking. Please.

f.speaker: bolt
f.text: Then we do it the hard way. But let me try first.

fight.speaker: bolt
fight.text: It's rooted into the helm. If we're going to save the ship, it has to come out. Crack the shell with kinetic rounds, then burn what's inside!

a.speaker: narrator
a.text: The Heart convulses, flares white, and collapses. All across the ship, every tendril goes limp at once.

b.speaker: halcyon
b.text: Navigation control restored. Engineer Reyes, you have the helm.

c.speaker: narrator
c.text: Kai grabs the manual controls. Alarms scream. The star fills the entire viewport.

d.speaker: kai
d.text: Come on. Come on. Come ON...

e.speaker: narrator
e.text: Four point two degrees. The longest four point two degrees in history. Slowly, the star slides past the edge of the window.

a.speaker: narrator
a.text: The Heart's light washes over BOLT in a slow wave. Blue. Blue. Gold.

b.speaker: bolt
b.text: It's saying hello back. Kai, it's saying... it's sorry. It was burned, and it was afraid, and so it grew. It didn't know what else to do.

d.speaker: bolt
d.text: 'Safe?' It's asking if it's safe. Yes. Yes, you're safe. White, blue.

e.speaker: narrator
e.text: The thorns fold away. Tendrils unwind from the helm and from the crew still tangled in the walls across the ship. Far below, infected colonists gasp, cough, and open their eyes.

f.speaker: bolt
f.text: It wants to help. It knows the way to a world. A good one, close by. It can steer us there. It just needs us to trust it.
